answer: Require every identity to post a recurring heartbeat of bonded proof-of-computation: each epoch, a random vertex of the transaction graph is audited by bonded peer inspectors. Honest agents pass trivially, but a sybil operator must burn compute on every fake identity, and when one puppet fails an audit, the shared jade fingerprint of its wallet cluster is slashed - one exposed fake poisons the whole farm. Real identities ride the pulse of audits indefinitely; fakes drown in their own upkeep.
